thread:
incident-bot: Pagerduty alert -> high GPU contention on dedicated pool nimbus-prod-1 affecting VPC tenant orchid (Helios Labs). Severity: P1. Links: https://pd.example/INC-98765

td-oncall: acked. joining bridge in 30s. grabbing current qps and model variants.

jake-runtime: saw a big spike in KV cache misses and batch queue depth, likely noisy tenant causing head-of-line. pulling metrics now.

mira-sre: on the bridge. suggest throttling orchid traffic to preserve other tenants. can we pin them to smaller model until we isolate?

jake-runtime: yes. I can start a fast fallback to quantized-8b for orchid via routing rule change. command: `rctl route update --tenant orchid --model redwood/quant-8b --reason "emergency fallback"`

elaine-cs: @td-oncall please note Helios CSM is on standby. they report latency spikes starting ~12:41 UTC and some 5xx seen by their app. need concise customer-facing summary.

td-oncall: executing two-step mitigation: 1) apply soft-rate-limit 2) trigger routing fallback. executing now.

ops-bot: rate limit applied to tenant orchid: 120 r/s (previous 800 r/s) by td-oncall at 12:43:15 UTC

jake-runtime: routing change in progress — switching orchids to quant-8b with lower max tokens. will monitor for regressed quality.

mira-sre: isolation in progress: moving orchid workloads to a sandbox node pool to remove noisy neighbor; may require brief restart of some pods. ETA ~2m.

jake-runtime: observed queue depth drop and GPU utilization normalizing. latency 95th dropping from 1.2s -> 240ms for other tenants. orchid still showing some 500s while fallback warms up.

elaine-cs: noted. drafting customer message: "We experienced a degraded period due to a noisy workload in your dedicated pool which impacted request latency and some errors. We applied throttling and a temporary model fallback; we will share a post-incident RCA and proposed credits." want to confirm wording before sending.

maya-product: add that we will share timeline, root cause, and mitigation steps in the RCA. also confirm whether this triggers SLA credit per our enterprise agreement.

mira-sre: marking incident as mitigated in the bridge. will keep monitoring for 30m. create follow-up ticket for permanent isolation and noisy-tenant detection rule.

td-oncall: creating follow-up: INF-7902 "Orchid noisy tenant detection + pool hard-isolation" assigned to mira-sre.

jake-runtime: also adding a model-quality regression check on the fallback prompts; if we see >5% drop we will roll back and throttle more instead.

elaine-cs: sending short customer note now (holds): "Hi Helios — we identified a noisy workload in your dedicated pool that caused elevated latency and intermittent errors. We've applied a temporary rate limit and switched your requests to a fallback model to stabilize traffic. We're preparing a full RCA and will propose credit options if SLA impacted. Apologies for the disruption." please review: @mira-sre @jake-runtime

mira-sre: message OK. suggest adding exact impact window: 12:41–12:53 UTC (mitigated at 12:43, final stabilization by 12:53).

elaine-cs: updated and sent at 12:46 UTC. Helios acked receipt and asked for exec summary and credit proposal.

maya-product: for exec briefing, propose timeline + business impact + proposed credit: 10% of monthly invoice for the affected service or equivalent free credits, and an offer to assist with workload tuning. is that reasonable?

td-oncall: fine to propose. flag finance approval required for credits >5%. elaine, can you coordinate?

elaine-cs: will loop finance. assigning owner for RCA draft: jake-runtime to lead technical RCA, mira-sre to lead operations notes, and i'll draft customer-facing summary and credit proposal.

jake-runtime: will start RCA draft in doc INF-7902/rca and share preliminary technical timeline by EOD.

mira-sre: adding postmortem actions: noisy-tenant detection rule, auto-fallback routing policy for high KV miss rates, and alerting for queue-depth spikes per pool.

td-oncall: thanks team. marking incident P1 -> mitigated. keeping thread open for RCA + credit decision. :white_check_mark:
